dialogues.speaker: Marine
dialogues.text: Hey there, Boss, look how hard I'm working! Could you see your way to upping my pay? That way, I can buy more gifts for Aeval.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Yeah, she's the guide on the Clementine Line aquabus. We used to be colleagues.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: For some reason, they transferred her away. Before she left, she would help me with all sorts of stuff — I've been looking for a way to thank her ever since.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: But there's me, working away, and I never seem to have the time. It's only recently that I've finally gotten the chance for some recreation.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: I originally asked Aeval to come with me, but she turned me down. She said something about "There's a big event going on, which means there'll be a lot of passengers to take care of"...

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: So I plan to get her some gifts instead!

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Elphane? So you're familiar with the "Scarlet Specter"?

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: To be perfectly honest, I've never been her biggest fan. She used to take all the most prestigious jobs for herself — it made me look like I wasn't pulling my weight.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Shooting, fighting... Ahem... I mean, she's got almost perfect grades in all the main professional skills.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: A talent like that, every time a holiday rolls around, she's sure to receive a deluge of gifts. She certainly doesn't need any more from me...

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Don't worry, I will! I'll approach this with the same vigor as though I was preparing for battle... Ahem, I mean, preparing for peaceful maritime labor!
